architecture_decisions.recommendation: Added trailing spaces to comment character definitions in language configuration files
architecture_decisions.rationale: The editor's comment toggling functionality uses the `line_comments` configuration to determine how to add/remove comments. By including the trailing space in the configuration, the editor will consistently add and remove the space when toggling comments, ensuring uniform behavior across all languages. This approach leverages the existing comment toggling infrastructure rather than creating language-specific logic.
alternatives_considered: Adding language-specific comment toggling logic in the editor core
Creating a separate configuration for comment spacing
Modifying the comment toggling algorithm to always add spaces regardless of configuration

architecture_decisions.rationale: Most languages in Zed already include trailing spaces in their comment configurations. alternatives_considered: Leaving the inconsistency as-is since it's a minor issue

Making the trailing space optional via user settings

architecture_decisions.recommendation: Modified only the language configuration files without touching editor logic or tests
architecture_decisions.rationale: The change is isolated to configuration files, making it low-risk and easy to review. tickets.title: Normalize comment spacing for Git Commit, Go Mod, and Go Work languages
tickets.description: Update language configurations to include trailing spaces in comment character definitions, ensuring consistent comment toggling behavior across all languages

implementation_summary:
This change addresses a consistency issue in comment toggling behavior by updating the language configuration files for Git Commit, Go Mod, and Go Work. The implementation adds trailing spaces to the `line_comments` configuration values, changing '#', '//', and '//' to '# ', '// ', and '// ' respectively.

The approach leverages Zed's existing language configuration system, where the `line_comments` field defines both the comment character(s) and any associated spacing. By including the space in the configuration, the editor's comment toggling functionality will automatically handle adding and removing the space when users toggle comments via keyboard shortcuts. This ensures that comment toggling behaves consistently across different file types, matching the behavior already established in most other languages in the codebase.

This minimal change follows the existing patterns in the codebase and requires no modifications to the editor's core logic. The change is isolated to configuration files, making it low-risk and easy to understand. The implementation assumes that the comment toggling system already properly handles the spacing defined in the `line_comments` configuration, which is a reasonable assumption given that most other languages already include trailing spaces in their configurations.
